title: Dr Dabber XS Nano eRig Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
THE LATEST eRig FROM DR DABBER

The Dr. Dabber XS is an advancement in the evolution of Dr Dabber technology, packed into the smallest, most portable e-Rig they have ever made. Providing the power and temperature stability you’ve come to expect from Dr Dabber’s bigger vaporizers, this purpose-built mini dab rig is specifically designed to go anywhere you need to go, comfortably.

Features like Dr Dabber’s original spill-proof glassware, alongside new additions such as a convenient filling tool and carb cap leash make the XS™ the ultimate travel companion. Carefully calibrated heat settings are controlled by Dr Dabber TCH technology, and based on almost a decade of customer feedback. This ensures a temperature range (475°, 525°, 575°, 625°) that will satisfy any dabber in any situation.

Designed to be simple to fill, load and use, the XS features Dr Dabber’s signature direct flavour pathway and a newly designed quartz heating dish with a beautiful knurling finish.

Dr Dabber XS™ Features:
Compatible with Concentrates
4 Precise Temperature (450° – 525°F)
TCR Heating Technology Increases Vapor Production
Pass-through USB-C Charging
Scientific-inspired Splash Free Glass Filtration System (or attachment)
Nano Compact Design
Smart Auto Shut-off Feature
Advanced Intuitive Design
1 Year Warranty

What’s in the Box:
1x – Dr. Dabber XS Nano e-Rig Vaporizer
1x – Loading Tool
1x – USB-C Universal Charger
